analyzed: tatra satyam brūyāt iti etat uktam satyavat ca idam anya padārtha antara vaktavyatayā tad viśeṣa artham vidhīyate priyam brūyāt iti saḥ yam adhunā ucyate viseṣaḥ na brūyāt satyam apriyam yathā brāhmaṇa kanyā te garbhiṇī iti ayam tāvat satya vacana apavādāt apriya vacanam idānīm apohyate priyam ca na anṛtam brūyāt yathā kanyāyām jātāyām brāhmaṇa putraḥ te jātaḥ iti tatra anena satyām gatau ajñānam āśrayitavyam asatyam tu para pīḍātaḥ atra vīddha
